The declared reference supplies the sharp BSSC support/contact result needed for the one-letter evaluation and supports its UV-converse interpretation.
scopeQualifications: The theorem applies to finite-alphabet discrete memoryless broadcast channels and arbitrary finite products.

The report does not independently certify the stronger quoted frontier value 0.369296945969202842443; non-improvement already follows from the weaker governed published endpoint 0.369316568803963.
